$comment: Local adaptations: manual updates only; sync-vendor.sh does not own these folders. Compare against these exact upstream commits and inspect every changed instruction/helper before updating.

sources.changes: Scoped triggers, conditional hub routing, local tracker default, persistent technical grilling, proportional diagnosis/TDD, evidence-based architecture review. See docs/workflow.md. 2026-11-07: to-spec, to-tickets and prototype name the UI skills for UI work (one line each).

adapted_resources.purpose: Persistent terminology and consequential decision rationale; existing grilling fork retained.

local_forks.base: v1.2.3 (6acc160e), same pin as the other skills in this entry
local_forks.diff_vs_upstream: SKILL.md +49/-6, plus a new workflow.md template (with a UI verification section added 2026-11-07). Every other file is byte-identical to v1.2.3.
local_forks.changes: Adds a Check run for already-configured repos (step 5, also runnable on its own), a Section D recording the repo's real verification commands, a diff-before-write rule for existing files, and docs/agents/workflow.md. No scripts - the skill stays prompt-driven. 2026-11-07: Section D also proposes UI verification rows (run/stop command, browser test command, viewports, themes, direction, screenshot auth) for repos with a rendered UI.
local_forks.evidence: 15/15 assertions vs 8/15 for v1.2.3 across three fixture repos; costs ~39% more wall time and ~10% more tokens.
local_forks.upstream_status: Not upstreamed; kept as a local fork.
local_forks.note: main has moved past v1.2.3 for this skill (em-dashes replaced with colons, YAML descriptions quoted). Those are house-style changes with no effect here. A main-based port of this same fork exists at files/setup-skill.patch if the whole entry is ever repinned.

upstream_review.finding: No new tag since v1.2.3; main is unreleased work. Across all 13 skills taken from this repo, the drift is almost entirely the repo-wide em-dash removal and a /skill-name to 'call the Skill tool' terminology audit. research and resolving-merge-conflicts are cosmetic-only at the word level.
upstream_review.adopted: One real bug, ported by hand: skills told the agent to invoke a skill marked disable-model-invocation, which cannot work. Fixed at four call sites (wayfinder, to-spec, to-tickets, and our own hub-workflow) to tell the user to run it instead. hub-workflow's `handoff` call had the same bug and is not inherited from upstream.
upstream_review.not_adopted: Em-dash and terminology churn: no behavioural effect and this hub has no such style rule. Upstream also deleted diagnosing-bugs' post-mortem recommendation to dodge the same bug; our fork already offers improve-codebase-architecture as separate scoped work, which keeps the value. Repinning all 13 skills to main buys nothing today.
